newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals were called to open mixed Monday as gold prices continued to gravitate around the key psychological $350 an ounce territory.
Bullion fell below $350 an ounce on Friday, and in early New York trading was quoted by dealers at $349.25/$349.75.
COMEX April gold was called to open up $0.50 to $1.00 an ounce from Friday's close. London bullion was fixed at $349.90 in the morning, down from $350.30 on Friday afternoon.
COMEX May silver was called to open flat to down 1.0 cent an ounce.
The yellow metal was still nervous following last week's announcement by Switzerland it planned to sell 40 tonnes of gold over ten years.
NYMEX April platinum was called to open $2.00 to $2.50 anounce firmer, while NYMEX June palladium was due to start trading flat to up $1.50 an ounce.
No major economic data was due for release Monday.
